বাংলাদেশে জ্ঞানভিত্তিক মনন গড়ে তোলাই পূর: East Bengal Renaissance aims to foster a culture of informed inquiry in Bangladesh. We seek a society where people can ask questions, examine evidence, think independently, and participate in knowledge and creativity. We want to connect Bengal’s own intellectual traditions with the pursuit of knowledge around the world.
ইউরোপীয় রেনেসাঁ থেকে অনুসন্ধিৎসা, সৃজনশী: We draw inspiration from the European Renaissance’s curiosity, creativity, and questioning of established ideas. In today’s context, we value democracy, equality, the environment, human dignity, and everyone’s participation in learning. We examine the achievements and limitations of an era rather than present it as a perfect ideal.
প্রতিষ্ঠিত তথ্য, লেখকের ব্যাখ্যা ও অনুমা: We will distinguish established facts from an author’s interpretation and assumptions. Wherever possible, we will link to original research, documents, and reliable sources. We will make uncertainty and research limitations explicit. We will not use opinion as a substitute for evidence.
দাবিকে যুক্তি ও প্রমাণের আলোকে বিচার করব: We will assess claims through reason and evidence. We will disclose authors’ relevant conflicts of interest. We prioritise criticism of ideas, actions, and policies rather than degrading people on the basis of group identity. We will make room for reasoned disagreement and respectful dialogue.
ভুল ধরা পড়লে যাচাই করে সংশোধন করব। অর্থব: When an error is identified, we will check and correct it. For substantive factual changes, the relevant article will state the correction and its date. Readers may send correction requests to our Facebook page with the article link, the problematic passage, and supporting sources.
লেখক, অনুবাদ ও ছবির কৃতিত্ব: Credits for authors, translations, and images
লেখা, তথ্য অনুসন্ধান ও সম্পাদনার কৃতিত্ব: We will credit writing, research, and editing. We will identify a translation’s original source and any necessary permission or licence. We will state sources and applicable reuse conditions for images, documents, and documentaries. We will not present realistic AI-generated images as historical photographs. We will disclose significant use of artificial intelligence in publications; editorial responsibility for verifying published facts remains with us.
স্পনসরকৃত লেখা, বিজ্ঞাপন বা অর্থপ্রদত্ত: We will clearly label sponsored writing, advertising, or paid partnerships, if any. We will disclose financial relationships relevant to a publication. This commitments page is not a list of current funding; relevant information will be published separately if funding begins.
বিষয় প্রস্তাব, যুক্তিসম্পন্ন প্রতিক্রিয়া: Topic suggestions, reasoned feedback, and correction requests are welcome. Please participate without publishing private or sensitive information.
